u0: The door has not been opened yet, so the door requirement is unmet and the target box remains inaccessible. The agent begins holding the matching key; keep possession of it, navigate to the locked door, and toggle the door open. Avoid dropping the key before the door opens, since that would trigger key_lost and leave the door locked.
u1: The door has been opened, satisfying the key-and-door requirement. This is the terminal RM success state: the reward has been achieved and there is no further RM objective. If the environment episode continues, complete the mission by entering the target room, dropping the carried key if the hands are still full, and picking up the mission-named box. This state remains terminal even if the door is later toggled closed.
